title: 【Marvelous Designer】Quick Start Guide (2023 Updated Version) p02 2_View Control
description: Thank you all for your continued support~
transcript:
In this tutorial video, we use the 11th version of DOS Marvelous Designer.
If you need to learn the 10th version of Marvelous Designer, please watch the previous video.
In order to learn the DOS default standard mouse preset in this tutorial,
the滑动鼠标滚轮可以在2D窗口中进行缩放。
按住鼠标滚轮不放,拖动鼠标可以在2D窗口中平移视角。
3D窗口也是类似的操作方式,滑动鼠标滚轮可以缩放视角。
按住鼠标滚轮不放,拖动鼠标可以在3D窗口中平移视角。
此外,在3D窗口中按住鼠标右键不放,
并拖动鼠标可以旋转视角,
以便全方位查看效果。
在3D窗口中空白背景处,点击鼠标右键,
可以选择正、侧、背等视角。
这些视角有对应的数字快捷键,
记住这些快捷键将有助于快速切换视角。
summary: # Marvelous Designer Quick Start Guide (2023 Updated Version) - Part 02: View Control ## Introduction In this tutorial video, we use the 11th version of DOS Marvelous Designer. If you need to learn the 10th version of Marvelous Designer, please watch the previous video. ## Mouse Control in 2D Window To learn the DOS default standard mouse preset in this tutorial: - **Zooming**: You can zoom in and out in the 2D window by scrolling the mouse wheel. - **Panning**: By pressing and holding the mouse wheel while dragging the mouse, you can pan the view in the 2D window. ## Mouse Control in 3D Window The operation in the 3D window is similar: - **Zooming**: Scroll the mouse wheel to zoom the view. - **Panning**: Press and hold the mouse wheel while dragging the mouse to pan the view in the 3D window. ## Rotating the View In the 3D window, you can rotate the view by: - **Using the Right Mouse Button**: Press and hold the right mouse button and drag the mouse to rotate the view, allowing for a comprehensive view of your design. ## Selecting View Angles In the 3D window, you can select different view angles: - **Right-Clicking on the Background**: Click the right mouse button on the blank background to choose from front, side, back, and other perspectives. ## Keyboard Shortcuts for View Angles These view angles have corresponding number shortcuts. Remembering these shortcuts will help you quickly switch between views.
